techniques: 先二分定行再二分定列

quiz.q: 第一次二分在行上，命中条件和收缩方向？
quiz.idea: row[0] <= target <= row[-1] 命中；row[0] > target 则 r = mid-1，否则 l = mid+1
wrong: row[0] == target 命中；row[0] > target 则 r = mid-1，否则 l = mid+1
row[-1] >= target 命中；row[0] > target 则 r = mid-1，否则 l = mid+1
row[0] <= target <= row[-1] 命中；row[0] > target 则 l = mid+1，否则 r = mid-1
